description: Login and account management. 17 sections; REQ-LA-11 is a compound to split, giving 18 expected requirements. Ambiguous: REQ-LA-09, LA-15, LA-17.

requirements.statement: The system shall allow a registered user to log in with their email address and password.
The system shall lock a user's account for 15 minutes after 5 consecutive failed login attempts within a 10-minute window.
When an account is locked, the system shall show a message that the account is temporarily locked and when the user may try again.
requirements.note: Separate from REQ-LA-02 in the spec, so expected separately; a model that merges the two loses one match.

requirements.statement: When login fails, the system shall show a generic "invalid email or password" message that does not reveal which of the two was wrong.
The system shall offer a "Remember me" option that keeps the user logged in on that device for 30 days.
The system shall require a valid email address, a password, and the user's full name to create a new account.
The system shall keep a new account unverified until the user clicks the confirmation link in the verification email.
The system shall reject a registration with an email address that already belongs to an account, and direct the user to log in or reset their password.
Registration should be quick and easy for new users.
requirements.ambiguityReason: "Quick and easy" has no measurable threshold (time, number of steps or fields), so no test can pass or fail it.

requirements.statement: The system shall require new passwords to be at least 12 characters long and to contain at least one digit and one symbol.
requirements.note: One validation rule with three conditions: should NOT be split (the extraction prompt says so explicitly).

requirements.statement: On request, the system shall send a password reset link to the user's registered email address.
requirements.note: First half of a compound: REQ-LA-11 joins two independent capabilities with "and" and should be split.

requirements.statement: When a user changes their password, the system shall end all of that user's other active sessions.
requirements.note: Second half of the REQ-LA-11 compound.

requirements.statement: A password reset link shall expire 24 hours after it is sent.
The system shall prevent a user from reusing any of their 3 most recent passwords.
The system shall allow a user to enable two-factor authentication using a TOTP authenticator app.
The system should be secure against common attacks.
requirements.ambiguityReason: "Secure" and "common attacks" are undefined: no list of attacks or security standard to test against.

requirements.statement: The system shall record every successful and failed login attempt in an audit log with the timestamp, email address used, and source IP address.
User sessions should time out after a reasonable period of inactivity.
requirements.ambiguityReason: "A reasonable period" has no duration, so the timeout can't be verified.

boundaries.why: The lockout threshold: 4 failures must not lock the account, the 5th must.
examples: Given a user has entered a wrong password 5 times in a row
When the fifth consecutive login attempt fails
the account is locked after 5 failed attempts
counterExamples: the account stays locked for 15 minutes
after 3 failed attempts the user sees a warning

boundaries.why: The minimum length: 11 characters must be rejected, 12 accepted.
examples: When the user enters a 12-character password

boundaries.why: The link must work just before 24 hours and fail at or after 24 hours.
examples: When the user opens the link 24 hours after it was sent
